verdict.rationale: The only API evidence is that POS UI extensions can call the GraphQL Admin API via fetch() (docs-36), alongside an extension SDK and CLI scaffolding (docs-34, docs-38, docs-39). That shows a programmatic surface exists, but nothing shows UI actions such as carts, checkout, staff PINs, approvals, or inventory counts can be done through it. missing for 10: documented API coverage of POS-specific workflows, any statement or evidence of API–UI parity, a standalone POS API reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
